closed_findings.finding: Pinned FreeRTOS Mainline taskDISABLE_INTERRUPTS writes BASEPRI directly and can weaken a stronger incoming mask.
closed_findings.counterexample: Incoming BASEPRI 0x40 with kernel ceiling 0x50 would reopen priority 0x40 on an unconditional store.
closed_findings.current_resolution: The default park uses the read-only Arch mask leaf. PRIMASK or FAULTMASK suppress any additional store; equal/stronger nonzero BASEPRI is retained; only zero/weaker BASEPRI takes the normal port disable path.
closed_findings.proof_scope: Read of current production, real pinned ARM_CM4F port macro and current death fixture. Owner regression execution is separate; this reviewer did not rerun it.

closed_findings.proof_scope: Read of central fail_stop, its bootstrap validation paths and external Tick setup_failed caller.

current_invariants: Core weak observer is stateless and returns without side effects; domain/reason/file/line do not create a retained event, registry or worker.
Default FreeRTOS assert/stack paths observe before terminal masking/park. Stack hook does not inspect possibly corrupt task/name pointers.
ThreadX central and M4 external-Tick failure paths observe before the product hook and park even if that hook returns.
Returning observation does not complete, cancel or reclaim accepted requests or provider storage.
Strong FreeRTOS assertion override is documented to remain non-returning and must explicitly invoke observation if preserving that observation contract.
limits: Observer boundedness, no reentrancy, no mask mutation, no OS lock and no request mutation are trusted product integration obligations; no mechanical callback timeout, reentrancy guard or strong-hook enforcement is added.
A functioning kernel, stack, clock, transport, peripheral permissions or privileged context is not established by observation.
Kernel BASEPRI masking does not prove high-priority IRQ, NMI, DMA or wire quiescence. ThreadX general failure park does not add a global interrupt mask.
No safety-output state, hardware reset, physical timing, HIL, MPU/SVC or TrustZone qualification follows from this review.
Owner raw RED/GREEN execution evidence remains distinct and was not rerun or counted as independent execution here.
